data.description: Esme Beach Residences: Modern Luxury with Panoramic Sea Views and Beach Access
data.display_address: Esme Beach Residences, Dubai Islands, Deira, Dubai
data.long_description:
Esme Beach Residences is a prestigious luxury development by Elysian Developments, located on the exclusive Island A in Dubai Islands. This remarkable property features a grand lobby on the ground floor, two podium levels, 19 floors of residential apartments, and a rooftop dedicated to exceptional amenities. Offering spacious one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments with modern, stylish interiors and well-thought-out layouts, each unit includes a private terrace. Panoramic sea views are available from the sixth floor upwards, while the building’s unique wavy façade adds a touch of contemporary architectural flair.

Residents can enjoy an array of world-class facilities, including a fully-equipped indoor gym, an aqua cycle pool, a children’s pool, and outdoor play areas. For relaxation, separate wellness zones for men and women provide saunas, showers, and cold plunge baths. The complex also features cozy lounge areas and ample parking for convenience.

Esme Beach Residences boasts an enviable location: a short walk to the beach, just 2 minutes from Dubai Island Mall, and 18 minutes to both Dubai Festival City and Dubai International Airport. The Museum of the Future is a 25-minute drive, while Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and Burj Al Arab are about 35 minutes away.
